findings.title: Verified implementation matches on-chain EIP-1967 slot
findings.description: At the latest measured block (128588409), the proxy's EIP-1967 implementation slot resolves to 0x6b5c44cbd4bbddf11723557ba1b77ec5e33225cc, which matches the supplied implementation address. The required comparison block (128449782) state was pruned, so the match is confirmed from latest state.

findings.title: Highly centralized owner privileges
findings.description: The owner can mint arbitrary amounts (no fixed supply cap), burn, freeze/unfreeze any address, pause/unpause all transfers, and transfer the separate autoOwner. renounceOwnership() is overridden to revert, so ownership cannot be renounced through the standard path.

findings.title: Privileged autoOwner with mint/burn powers
findings.description: autoOwner can call autoMint (bounded per call by autoMintMaxLimit and a monotonic nonce) and autoBurn (burns owner()'s balance). The owner can change autoOwner at any time.

findings.title: Upgradeable proxy with unknown admin custody
findings.description: The proxy admin slot is 0x1e33d209c18f51d97f66ea461c6f819b59e78b30. No timelock, multisig, or governance controls are visible in the verified source or RPC state, so the admin can atomically change the implementation logic.

findings.title: EIP-7598 authorization flow appears sound
findings.description: transferWithAuthorization and receiveWithAuthorization use _hashTypedDataV4, SignatureCheckerUpgradeable (EOA + EIP-1271), mark bytes32 nonces as used, enforce strict validAfter/validBefore bounds, and require receive caller == payee. cancelAuthorization is restricted to the authorizer.

findings.title: Slither findings are mostly OZ false positives and low-impact shadowing
findings.description: The high-impact incorrect-exp and divide-before-multiply detections are inside OpenZeppelin MathUpgradeable assembly and are known Slither false positives. Remaining findings are local variable shadowing and timestamp usage with low exploitability.

findings.title: Testnet deployment with minimal history
findings.description: Contract is on BNB Testnet (chainId 97). Proxy transactionCount is 1. Total supply measured at latest block is 10005250000000000000000000000 (10,005,250 U with 18 decimals). No holder, liquidity, or sellability data was gathered.

reasons: Source verification and the on-chain EIP-1967 implementation slot match, but code correctness alone is insufficient for a stablecoin to be trusted.
The owner retains unilateral, uncapped mint/burn/freeze/pause authority and can upgrade the proxy logic at any time.
A separate autoOwner key can mint and burn under owner-controlled limits, adding another centralization point.
No timelock, multisig, supply cap, or governance constraints are visible in the source or RPC state.
Ownership cannot be renounced through the standard renounceOwnership path because it is hardcoded to revert.
The deployment is on BNB Testnet with minimal on-chain history and no evidence of holder distribution, liquidity, or sellability.
EIP-7598 authorization logic and Slither review do not offset the above privileged-control risks.
requiredActions: Disclose and verify custody of both the proxy admin key and the contract owner/autoOwner keys (e.g., multisig, hardware security modules, timelock).
If long-term trust is intended, remove or time-lock privileged functions, enforce a transparent and immutable mint cap, and transfer proxy admin to a timelock or governance contract.
Treat the token as testnet-only and avoid using it for mainnet value or production settlement without further independent audit.
Re-run static analysis and perform a full manual audit focused on EIP-7598 signature validation and upgrade storage-layout safety.
Monitor Upgrade, OwnershipTransferred, AutoOwnerTransferred, Pause, Freeze, and Mint/Burn events continuously if any reliance is maintained.
coverage: Explorer-verified first-party source units: src/Stablecoin.sol, src/StablecoinV2.sol, src/libraries/EIP7598Constants.sol
Dependency manifest for OpenZeppelin upgradeable contracts (analyzed by Slither, not supplied as ordinary LLM source)
Fresh local Slither 0.11.6 output (normalized wrapper output)
Direct read-only RPC evidence at requiredComparisonBlock 128449782 and latest block 128588409
limitations: Historical state at the required comparison block (#128449783) is pruned; many eth_call/eth_getStorageAt values at that block are unavailable, so verification relies on latest state.
No holder concentration, DEX liquidity, executed sellability, timelock, key-custody, or off-chain reputation evidence was collected or inferred.
Slither detections are unreviewed signals; the high-severity findings in OpenZeppelin MathUpgradeable are treated as false-positive assembly parsing.
This assessment is limited to the supplied artifacts and does not include runtime transaction simulation or full manual dependency-source review.
